reviewUpdated: **Updated:** 17 November 2026 — Run 07 native tile-origin correction, actual window/large-text verification and retained failures. Original findings and earlier snapshots remain historical; [the delivery ledger](DELIVERY_PLAN.md#complete-scope-and-resolution-ledger) owns current status.
planCurrentState: **Current state:** Run 07 corrects native tile baseline alignment using actual pixel-rounded parent/box positions, without changing fonts, design metrics or tolerances. Android's strict `TREE` failure is cleared; default/dark/enlarged contexts and actual split-screen resizing pass tile checks. iOS Debug now exposes the missing native events, and expanded maximum iPad raster coverage passes; final phone/build scopes are recorded separately in [Run 07 evidence](evidence/run07/README.md). **P05 remains active**: ordinary Android text retains stale sizing and enlarged headings/instructions/feedback/action labels clip. P05.2/.8 remain partial: relevant R06/R07 accessibility rechecks fail, and new DPR 3 maximum iPhone word edges (`India` and `Juliett`) exceed the unchanged 2 px raster limit by up to 0.042447 px despite exact baselines. P05.6/.7 retain delivery; P00–P04 remain agent-done. Shared checks pass 84 tests, types/lint, the Expo-free scan and scoped production-web regression. P07.2 still lacks UI/audio integration; P06/P07.4/P08–P10 and M11 remain unfinished. [Source identity](evidence/run07/source-identity.json). This is not release approval.
